claims.claim: In this evaluation CV is better at1/5 saved minutes and HSM-SDE at15/30; better means lower average ES.
RDM-SDE has lower observed average ES and30-minute mean-position error than the main HSM-SDE model; its ES difference interval crosses zero, so a consistent ES advantage is not established.
120/300s observation configurations lower average ES relative to60s HSM-SDE;300s increases final mean-position error.
Examined training/adaptation variants make small average ES changes relative to the original training/adaptation procedure; no additional ES decrease is confirmed.
claims.qualification: Not a claim that training itself has no value.

claims.claim: A nominal90% disk encloses about90% of512simulated positions; empirical coverage measures actual target inclusion. HSM-SDE30-minute inclusion is46.52%, not near90%.
explanations: mean error: distance of centre from truth
an entire-city circle may cover more but localise poorly
centre error, not only radius, can cause misses

claims.claim: On the post-hoc43-block subset, current all-terrain is worse than historybase on average ES(+26.98m) and30-minute mean error(+39.00m); simply adding all terrain features did not give average benefit here.
Adding current road features accompanies worse scores; removing them improves scores in these fitted configurations.
River-only benefit at15minutes does not extend to30minutes; improvement at a shorter horizon does not guarantee improvement farther ahead.
Landcover-only lowers average ES1.64m and final mean error5.96m, a small favourable observed mean.

terrain_interpretation.statement: Terrain information has not been shown to reliably help prediction in this evaluation. Current handling of terrain may have shortcomings.
terrain_interpretation.basis: nearest-feature directions are not road tangents or explicit river-crossing constraints; fitting and rollout may also matter
not_claimed: a diagnosed software or feature bug
